posts.cooked:
NOTE: This villain used to be called "The Assistant", but on Jan 3, 2013 it was revealed that this was... misinformation and her name is really "Miss Information".  Oh, the puns!  So, be forewarned and don't be confused by a thread that refers to a villain by an old name.

So... anyone out there planning on running to their friends and saying, "Oh man, you GOTTA back this Kickstarter!  I mean, we just hit a new reward level, and now we get to fight the superhero's executive assistant!  Wicked!"? ;)

My wife thinks the new villain is creative, but I think you still need to leaven your creativity with awesomeness.  This villain seems to have plenty of the former and be a bit lacking in the latter...

(I know an Assistant discussion has already started in one of the other many jumbled topics all related to the Kickstarter, but it's getting hard to find things, so I thought I'd separate this one out into its own thread).

This is the promo Villain - the Awesome, Epic, fear-inspiring ones will be those in the expansion (or I hope so).

We also have to remember that we know nothing but her name, picture, backstory and unflipped description -nothing about her game play. She is not the most awe-inspiring villain at first sight, but she may be our worst nightmare when we'll play against her :) Let's hope we'll know more about her gameplay (and the game play of each deck in the expansion) as we reach new updates...

But I agree that, right now, she is not an easy sell, but as a reward for fans, I think she works, by adding more backstory to the Freedom Five - and more drama.

posts.name: EvanDan55
posts.cooked:
Yeah, my initial thoughts were "How the heck is this going to work?" But when you think about it, this entry made second place. Here's the thing: I've seen a ton of good entries on the other threads that had awesome gameplay mechanics and terrifying villains to boot. So basically, I see it like this: The Assisant's level of terror is going to come from her deck. I think she's going to be holding people hostage, and sabotaging our things before we go out into battle.

Essentially, this villain is going to be all about themeing and story. She has decided to take revenge on the heroes, and she plans it out carefully. The battle against her is going to take place after she's done everything she needs to. So while we're tracking down this crazed-woman, suddenly, all of our equipment fails! She had prepared for that before she went off, possibly seeking out those five people we saved instead of her and killing them. She might be like Spite; tracking down victims like those five people (or even the heroes' families), but instead of a drug-powered killer, she'll just be a venegeful, unexpected killer.

When we're attacking her, we're not actually blasting her with fire or punches--we're tracking her down while she exacts whatever revenge she has planned.

Like I said: if this got second place, she's got to have something wicked in store, but she's hiding it very well.

Seriously though, if there end up to be one-shots where the villain deals (H-1) heroes coffee damage, or they get stuck doing filing and so have to skip their turn, I'll be very sad.

Are you kidding, that sounds hilarious! Even better: skip your turn and sort your deck by card title in alphabetical order, and it hangs out as an ongoing that gives you "POWER: destroy this card to shuffle your deck."

Not every villain needs to be Apostate. Having a handful of less-serious comic relief type villains would be a good thing, IMO. There's a lot of comedy in the flavor text, but we haven't seen a really outlandish funny villain until now.

Plus, $5 says her flip side has her maniacally flipping out and it does look classically villainous. And suitably awesome.
